raw_payload.what_happens: Lakhā bursts into the courtyard, eyes blazing, assuming the dog has fled. In a fit of fury, he seizes a sturdy wooden stick and strikes the dog's head. The camera lingers on the stunned faces of the onlookers, the sound of the blow echoing through the still afternoon air.
